data.title: 爱西亚 · 浴室水汽中的羞怯擦背
data.description: 深木色浴缸内热水升腾，纯白比基尼早已在水中解开飘走。爱西亚双颊滚烫如熟透苹果，小心翼翼地把满是细腻泡沫的双手贴在你后背上，在紧密相贴的心跳中羞怯娇喘。
data.location: steamy private bathroom with aromatic bath bubbles
data.action: sitting together in steamy deep bathtub, untied white swimsuit falling away in water, hugging partner back with soapy trembling hands, cheeks blushing crimson
data.lighting: diffused warm ceiling light reflecting in misty water vapor
data.mood: shy domestic intimacy, soapy water warmth, trembling heart-racing innocence
data.promptProse: In a steamy bathtub with untied white swimsuit, Asia blushes furiously while hugging partner back with soapy trembling hands.
data.animaCaption: Asia Argento blushing furiously while washing partner back in bathtub.
